HALLUCINATIONS:
- The memo states “General run rate cost savings and restructuring charges limited to 12.5% of Consolidated EBITDA,” but the source caps the aggregate addbacks under clauses (xi) and (xii) to the amount by which 12.5% of Consolidated EBITDA exceeds the aggregate amounts added back under clauses (xiii) and (xiv) for the same period. The memo omits this netting requirement.
